tips.title: 1. Keep It Short & Sharp
tips.desc: Your domain should be quick to type, easy to recall, and look great on every platform - clarity wins every time.

tips.title: 2. Simplicity Always Wins
tips.desc: Skip the complicated stuff - no extra hyphens, numbers, or tricky spellings. A clean name makes a lasting impact.

tips.title: 3. Make It Yours
tips.desc: Blend your brand or niche keywords into your domain. It’s how people remember you, not just your website.

tips.title: 4. Verify Before You Buy
tips.desc: A quick search saves future trouble - ensure your name is available and not already trademarked.

tips.title: 5. Choose the Right Extension
tips.desc: Think beyond “.com.” Local or niche extensions like .in, .co, or .tech can make your domain stand out.

tips.title: 6. Don’t Wait Too Long
tips.desc: Good names go fast. Once you find the perfect fit, lock it down with ICSDC before someone else does.

faq.question: How do I register a domain with ICSDC?
faq.answer: Search your desired name on our domain checker, choose your preferred extension, and complete the registration in a few clicks.

faq.question: Can I transfer my existing domain to ICSDC?
faq.answer: Yes, you can easily transfer your domain to ICSDC with zero downtime and full support throughout the process.

faq.question: Will my personal details be protected?
faq.answer: Absolutely. ICSDC offers WHOIS privacy protection to keep your personal information safe and hidden from public records.

faq.question: What if my desired domain name is already taken?
faq.answer: Try alternative extensions or variations — our smart search tool helps you find the closest available match instantly.

faq.question: Does ICSDC offer support after registration?
faq.answer: Yes! Our expert support team is available 24/7 to assist you with setup, renewals, DNS management, and more.

faq.question: How long does a domain registration last?
faq.answer: Most domains can be registered for 1 year, and you can extend them for multiple years. Some extensions may require a longer minimum term.

faq.question: Can I change my domain after registering?
faq.answer: No, domain names can’t be renamed. You can register a new one and redirect your old domain to it.

faq.question: What are TLDs, ccTLDs, and gTLDs?
faq.answer: TLD: The ending of a domain (e.g., .com) ccTLD: Country-specific TLDs (e.g., .in, .uk) gTLD: General TLDs like .com, .net, .online, etc.

faq.question: What if the name I want is unavailable?
faq.answer: Try a different extension or a slight variation of your name. Our domain search will also suggest available alternatives.
